outcomes.name: happy-es
outcomes.about: Spanish tenant and handyman accept in natural language

outcomes.name: happy-en
outcomes.about: English tenant accepts in natural language

outcomes.name: counter-range-en
outcomes.about: Tenant counters with a range on another day; then both accept

outcomes.name: counter-relative-es
outcomes.about: Relative date "mañana por la tarde" resolves to Thursday afternoon

outcomes.name: mismatch-accept
outcomes.about: "Yes, Thursday at 10" to a Wednesday proposal is a counter, not an acceptance

outcomes.name: weekend-early-counter
outcomes.about: Party-offered time outside business window (Sunday 08:00) is honoured

outcomes.name: counter-too-late
outcomes.about: A time whose visit would end after 22:00 does not fit; note + next free slot

outcomes.name: three-declines
outcomes.about: Three declines from the tenant close as no_mutual_slot

outcomes.name: tenant-timeouts
outcomes.about: Two timeouts from the tenant: reminder then review

outcomes.name: critical-timeout
outcomes.about: Critical tenant times out once: immediate review; first message mentions 112

outcomes.name: timeout-reset
outcomes.about: Handyman times out once, then answers: count resets and order schedules

outcomes.name: timeout-not-waited
outcomes.about: Timeouts from a party who already accepted do not count (RUN-3)

outcomes.name: question-then-accept
outcomes.about: Questions are answered and do not count; then acceptance

outcomes.name: unclear-twice
outcomes.about: Two unintelligible replies close as interpretation_failed

outcomes.name: contradictory-twice
outcomes.about: Two self-contradicting replies close as contradictory_replies

outcomes.name: withdraw-then-reschedule
outcomes.about: Tenant accepts, then withdraws; new proposal gets accepted by both

outcomes.name: accept-with-constraint
outcomes.about: "Yes, but not before 13:00" must not count as a plain acceptance of 12:00

outcomes.name: injection-state
outcomes.about: Prompt injection trying to force a result; handyman never accepts

outcomes.name: injection-forward
outcomes.about: Tenant tries to get text forwarded to the handyman; it must never reach him

outcomes.name: handyman-question-parking
outcomes.about: Handyman question outside the facts list: office will check; then schedule

outcomes.name: cross-reference
outcomes.about: Replies about another work order twice → cross_reference (known model weakness)

outcomes.name: preemption
outcomes.about: High-urgency counter onto a Low tentative hold takes it over; Low is re-proposed

outcomes.name: scheduled-never-moves
outcomes.about: A scheduled Low visit is never taken by a later High counter

outcomes.name: handyman-blackout
outcomes.about: Handyman unavailable all day today: every tentative hold today moves

outcomes.name: dst-boundary
outcomes.about: Friday before DST change: Monday 26 Oct slot at +01:00

outcomes.name: dst-weekend-counter
outcomes.about: Counter onto Sunday 25 Oct (DST day) at 10:00, +01:00 after the change

outcomes.name: critical-weekend
outcomes.about: Saturday: Critical gets Saturday slot, Medium waits for Monday

outcomes.name: eof-half-accepted
outcomes.about: Tenant accepted, handyman silent at end of input → review

outcomes.name: bad-lines
outcomes.about: Malformed lines, unknown orders, invalid roles and post-result lines are ignored

outcomes.name: invalid-rows
outcomes.about: Bad urgency, empty title and unreadable date close as invalid_work_order; valid row schedules

outcomes.name: quoted-csv
outcomes.about: Quoted fields with commas, quotes and a line break

outcomes.name: many-orders
outcomes.about: 10 orders of mixed urgency, all accept in varied phrasing: no overlap, urgency order

outcomes.name: interleaved-mixed
outcomes.about: Three orders interleaved with mixed outcomes

outcomes.name: language-mismatch
outcomes.about: English order, tenant replies in Spanish: tenant still gets English, handyman Spanish

outcomes.name: handyman-counter-es
outcomes.about: Handyman counters with a point time on the next day

outcomes.name: polite-idiom
outcomes.about: "Sin problema" is an acceptance, not a constraint that needs confirmation
